case.summary: This alert was triggered when the bank's real-time model scored online transaction 3506725 for $1,000.03 at 0.90. Investigation showed the purchase was unusually large for the card and originated from a new device profile, though the transaction model scored it at only 0.005. The cardholder was contacted and confirmed the purchase was made from their own new device, resulting in a legitimate verdict. The final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
